items.stem: In Korean, what is the main difference between the topic marker and the subject marker?

options.text: The topic marker frames what the sentence is about; the subject marker identifies the grammatical subject
options.rationale: Correct: they serve different discourse and grammatical roles and are not interchangeable.

options.text: They are identical and always interchangeable
options.rationale: They differ in function and often change nuance.

options.text: The subject marker is only used in questions
options.rationale: The subject marker is not restricted to questions.

options.text: The topic marker only appears on verbs
options.rationale: Markers attach to nouns/noun phrases, not verbs.

items.explanation: Correct: they serve different discourse and grammatical roles and are not interchangeable.

items.stem: A learner reads a passage and recognizes only one word in a sentence. What is the best comprehension strategy?

options.text: Use surrounding context and sentence structure to infer overall meaning
options.rationale: Correct: context and structure support comprehension beyond a single word.

options.text: Assume the sentence means whatever that one word means
options.rationale: One word rarely carries the whole sentence's meaning.
Skipping forfeits comprehension that context could provide.

options.text: Translate every word with no attention to grammar
options.rationale: Ignoring grammar loses meaning that structure conveys.

items.explanation: Correct: context and structure support comprehension beyond a single word.

items.stem: Select TWO factors that should guide the choice of verb ending in Korean.

options.text: The level of politeness or formality required
options.rationale: Correct: speech level/honorifics depend on social context.

options.text: The relationship and status between speakers
options.rationale: Correct: relative status shapes the honorific ending chosen.
This is irrelevant to verb endings.

options.text: The number of pages in the textbook
options.rationale: This has no bearing on ending choice.

options.text: The time of day the sentence is written
options.rationale: Time of day does not determine the verb ending.

items.explanation: Correct: speech level/honorifics depend on social context. Correct: relative status shapes the honorific ending chosen.
